analysis.tempoNote: Approximately 76 BPM at a slow pulse, or 152 BPM at double time. Multiple starting-tempo beat trackers and an independent rhythm estimator agree on this pulse family. This does not certify a fixed beat grid.
analysis.keyNote: STFT chroma, constant-Q chroma and all three HPCP profiles agree on D major globally. One local window suggests A major. This is an automated tonal estimate, not a verified score.
analysis.method: Automated waveform, rhythm and tonal analysis; BPM and key are estimates. No listening verification.
